field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Master switch. Off by default: the Product Attachments fieldset is absent from the product edit page, uploads are refused, and no email carries attachments. Files already in the media folder are left untouched.

field.label: Media Directory
field.comment: Folder under pub/media holding one sub-folder per product, named after the product SKU (or its numeric id). Files dropped there by hand are picked up exactly like uploaded ones. One path segment: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

field.label: Attach To
field.comment: Which sales email carries the files. Order comment/update emails are never attached to, only the emails selected here.

field.label: Show On Product Page
field.comment: Independent of Enabled above: lists this product's attachments (uploaded files and external links) as downloadable chips on its storefront page, between Product Features and Product Description. Off by default — a merchant can mail attachments without publishing them, or the reverse.

field.label: Allowed Extensions
field.comment: Comma-separated, no dots. Applies to uploads AND to files dropped in by hand — anything else in the folder is ignored, never mailed. Executable types (php, phtml, sh, exe, …) are always refused whatever is listed here.

field.label: Maximum File Size (bytes)
field.comment: Per file, on upload and on attach. Default 10485760 (10 MB). A larger file already in the folder is skipped and logged.

field.label: Maximum Total Size Per Email (bytes)
field.comment: Default 20971520 (20 MB). Most mail servers reject more; files past the budget are skipped and logged rather than the email failing.

field.label: Maximum Files Per Email
field.comment: Default 10. An order of many products can otherwise mail dozens of files.
